descriptionChirho: The personal name Nahshon (נַחְשׁוֹן), leader of the tribe of Judah during the wilderness period and ancestor of David. All three clusters are the same name with grammatical variation (conjunction waw 'and'). Transliterations are consistent across languages: Arabic نَحْشُون (Nahshun), Swahili 'Nashoni,' Hindi नहशोन (Nahshon), Korean 나손 (Nason), Spanish 'Naasón/Najsón.' The name appears in genealogical lists (Num 1:7, 2:3, 7:12,17, 10:14; Ruth 4:20; 1 Chr 2:10-11) always referring to the same individual.
